what: Atiths served by good Brahmans at ceremonies but with own Gurus; mainly worship Siva (flowers, sometimes goats), also godlings Bandi and Goraiya in Saran; ascetics and some householders bury the dead seated (samadhi) or float bodies in the Ganges; ascetics offer pinda only to deceased spiritual leaders; marry outside father's gotra; remarriage restricted.
quote: The Atiths are served by good Brahmans on ceremonial occasions, but their Gurus or spiritual guides are taken from their own community.

what: Gharbari Atith practice: sometimes burn their dead but both they and the Sannyasis usually bury them sitting with clasped hands (samadhi).
quote: but both they and the Sannyasis usually bury them in a sitting position with their hands clasped as in meditation.
